## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

For the `test` subcommand only, tk runs buck2 as a child process, not handing over the process. After buck2's summary it prints `N recorded`, from a count the runner leaves behind. Every other subcommand still hands over the process (spec §2).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `tk test` prints `N recorded` after the summary
- [ ] The exit code is exactly buck2's
- [ ] Signals (Ctrl-C) reach buck2 as before
- [ ] Other subcommands still hand over the process

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.6
title: tk test prints the recorded count
